## Hotfix: 1.20.6

- **Exit is back** on the tray menu (it had been cut off below the bottom edge) and on the RustWarden menu.
- **First-run wizard:** the window is bigger and stays the same size on every step, so it no longer scrolls or jumps back to the centre when you press Next.
- **See-through windows:** windows opened from Settings, such as a plugin's Settings or Permissions, are now solid. Before, they could turn almost completely transparent, starting with the ThinkBroadband plugin's settings.
- **Dialogs:** a dialog sizing itself to fit its content can no longer grow past the screen. Before, it could keep resizing every frame, which puts a lot of load on some integrated graphics chips.
- **Speedtest:** upload is drawn in the same orange as upload on the Traffic tab.
- **Firewall > Windows components:** "Repeat that automatically" is now "Keep these components blocked", with a clearer description: it re-blocks components that Windows Update put back.
- **Docs:** a [user guide](https://rustwarden.github.io/RustWarden/) is now linked from the top of the README.
